meta.project: Shree Brijwasi Jatav Samaj Sewa Samiti Website

product_overview: A Django-based public website for Shree Brijwasi Jatav Samaj Sewa Samiti that showcases projects and media, accepts UPI donations, and manages volunteer registrations with admin verification and email notifications.
core_goals: Provide a compelling online presence that communicates the NGO's mission and impact
Enable seamless UPI-based online donations with transaction tracking and admin verification
Support volunteer registration, review and approval workflows
Showcase work projects and media with fast-loading, responsive pages
Enable non-technical administrators to manage content via Django admin
Support easy deployment from localhost to production via a centralized config

features.name: Core Views (Public Pages)
features.description: Public-facing pages for the site (home, about, team, our work, donate, media, contact, volunteer) served by simple GET endpoints.
user_flows: GET / -> Receive 200 with homepage HTML including slider_images, site_settings, featured_projects and statistics
GET /about/overview/ -> Receive 200 with about_overview, mission_statement and vision_statement
GET /about/team/ -> Receive 200 with active team members and leadership sections
GET /our-work/ -> Receive 200 with paginated project listing and filter metadata
GET /our-work/<slug>/ -> Receive 200 with project detail, gallery_images and related_projects
GET /donate/ -> Receive 200 with donation form, suggested_amounts and upi_apps
GET /donate/thank-you/ -> Receive 200 thank-you page for donation initiations
GET /media/ -> Receive 200 with media gallery listing and filter metadata
GET /contact/ -> Receive 200 with contact form and contact_info
GET /volunteer/ -> Receive 200 with volunteer registration form and area/availability choices
GET /our-work/nonexistent-slug/ -> Receive 404 when requested project slug does not exist

features.name: Home Page (Landing)
features.description: Serve the primary landing page with hero slider, impact statistics, featured projects and CTAs to donate or volunteer.
user_flows: GET / -> Receive 200 with slider_images, site_settings, featured_projects and cached statistics
GET / -> Receive 500 with friendly error page if SiteSettings or required config is missing (server/config error)

features.name: About Overview
features.description: Public about/overview page delivering NGO history, mission, vision and timeline content from SiteSettings.
user_flows: GET /about/overview/ -> Receive 200 with about_overview, mission_statement, vision_statement and years_of_operation
GET /about/overview/ -> Receive 500 with error message if SiteSettings record is missing or DB error occurs

features.name: About Team
features.description: Public team listing showing active team members and leadership profiles.
user_flows: GET /about/team/ -> Receive 200 with leadership and team_members ordered by display_order
GET /about/team/ -> Receive 500 if database read error occurs (e.g., DB connection failure)

features.name: Our Work - Listing
features.description: List and filter work projects with pagination and aggregate statistics.
user_flows: GET /our-work/?category=education&status=completed&page=1 -> Receive 200 with paginated projects, categories list and statistics
GET /our-work/?page=abc -> Receive 400 with validation error 'invalid page parameter'

features.name: Work Project Detail
features.description: Serve a single project's full details, gallery and related projects (increments view count).
user_flows: GET /our-work/<slug>/ -> Receive 200 with project data, gallery_images, related_projects and views_count incremented
GET /our-work/nonexistent-slug/ -> Receive 404 Not Found when slug does not match a published project

features.name: Donation Flow (UPI)
features.description: Allow donors to initiate UPI donations: collect donor details, create pending donation record, generate UPI deep link and show thank-you page; admin verifies completion later.
user_flows: GET /donate/ -> Receive 200 with donation form, minimum_donation, suggested_amounts and upi_apps

POST /donate/ with valid donor_name, donor_email, amount >= MINIMUM_DONATION and payment_app -> Receive 201 with transaction_reference and upi_deep_link (upi://pay?... or app-specific scheme) and donation record created with payment_status='pending'
GET /donate/thank-you/?ref=<transaction_reference> -> Receive 200 thank-you page showing transaction_reference and verification instructions
POST /donate/ with amount < MINIMUM_DONATION or missing required fields -> Receive 400 with validation errors describing required fields

features.name: Donation Verification (Admin)
features.description: Admin verifies a pending UPI donation by marking it completed, adding UPI transaction id and triggering receipt email.
user_flows: GET /admin/donations/<transaction_reference>/ -> Receive 200 with donation details and current payment_status='pending'

POST /admin/donations/<transaction_reference>/verify/ with upi_transaction_id and action=mark_completed -> Receive 200 with updated payment_status='completed', completed_at timestamp and confirmation that receipt email was queued/sent
POST /admin/donations/INVALID_REF/verify/ -> Receive 404 when transaction_reference is not found

features.name: Volunteer Registration
features.description: Collect volunteer applications, create pending volunteer records, send welcome email and notify admin for approval.
user_flows: GET /volunteer/ -> Receive 200 with volunteer registration form, area_choices and availability_choices

POST /volunteer/ with valid name, unique email, phone, skills, preferred_area and terms_accepted -> Receive 201 with volunteer id and status='pending' and welcome email queued to volunteer and admin notification queued
GET /volunteer/thank-you/ -> Receive 200 with registration confirmation and next steps
POST /volunteer/ with an email already registered (status pending or approved) -> Receive 409 Conflict with message 'email already registered'

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Accept inquiries through a contact form, validate reCAPTCHA, persist submission and send auto-reply and admin notification.
user_flows: GET /contact/ -> Receive 200 with contact form and contact_info from config
POST /contact/ with valid name, email, subject, message and valid reCAPTCHA token -> Receive 201 with submission id; auto-reply email queued to sender and admin notification queued
POST /contact/ with invalid reCAPTCHA token -> Receive 403 with error 'reCAPTCHA verification failed'

features.name: Media Gallery
features.description: Expose photos and videos with filtering, pagination and lightbox-ready metadata.
user_flows: GET /media/?category=events&media_type=image&page=1 -> Receive 200 with paginated media_items and categories
GET /media/?media_type=unknown -> Receive 400 with validation error 'invalid media_type'
